## About
Certi-Fix is the service department of Special Rims, Inc., and wheel repair is what we do. If your wheels are bent, we fix them. If they are scratched, we restore them. We work on factory OEM wheels and aftermarket wheels, alloy or chrome.
Our shop runs CNC machines and welding equipment, and our technicians are trained to get each job right. Customers have given us a 4.3 rating from 45 Google reviews, and we would like to earn the next one from you.

## Services
- Fix bent wheels: If your wheels are bent, we straighten and fix them.
- Weld cracked wheels: Cracked wheels welded and put back in service.
- Restore scratched wheels: We resurface scratched wheels so they look right again.
- Wheel polishing: We polish wheels at our Riverdale shop.
- Wheel balance: Wheel balancing done at our Riverdale shop.
- Customize wheels: Bolt pattern conversion, offset changes and custom paint.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of wheels do you work on?
A: Both factory OEM wheels and aftermarket wheels, whether they are alloy or chrome.

Q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
A: Yes, we offer local pickup and delivery in many Georgia cities, including Riverdale, Atlanta, Marietta, Forest Park, College Park and Jonesboro.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
